articulation.label: home
articulation.alt: home: /h/ → /oʊ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

sections: Mia lives in a building near her school. Her home is a flat, also called an apartment. She rents it from the owner, who lives next door. It is small, but she likes the short walk to class. She can live there without needing a car.
